definitions: A free software community best known for producing the Firefox web browser.
The name of the original web browser project that eventually led to the creation of Netscape Navigator.
A fictional monster mascot for the Netscape browser, a Godzilla-like creature.
examples: Many people contribute to Mozilla's open-source projects.
The history of the web is intertwined with Mozilla.
The Mozilla mascot was a playful nod to its origins.
